title: Attributes and predictors of long COVID

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Attributes and predictors of long COVID》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Reports of long-lasting coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) symptoms, the so-called 'long COVID', are rising but little is known about prevalence, risk factors or whether it is possible to predict a protracted course early in the disease.

evidence.text: Reports of long-lasting coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) symptoms, the so-called 'long COVID', are rising but little is known about prevalence, risk factors or whether it is possible to predict a protracted course early in the disease.

sections.text:
《Attributes and predictors of long COVID》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Experiencing more than five symptoms during the first week of illness was associated with long COVID (odds ratio = 3.53 (2.76-4.50)).
